free_tier_limits.correction: 12 months free: 250,000 messages (512-byte metering), 250,000 registry or Device Shadow operations, 250,000 rules triggered, and 250,000 actions executed; always-free FreeRTOS not applicable. Limits and meter size vary by region (e.g. messages metered in 5 KB increments in some regions).

rate_limits.correction: Documented per-account, per-region API throttling quotas (e.g. DescribeEndpoint 10 TPS default; many control-plane APIs have published default quotas). See Service Quotas / IoT Core quotas docs — not "not published".

example.correction: ListThings is GET /things but requires proper SigV4 signing (not a raw Authorization header with YOUR_API_KEY). Endpoint must be the account-specific control-plane endpoint from DescribeEndpoint (or regional iot.<region>.amazonaws.com with correct signing). Path exists; example auth form is misleading/incomplete.

notes: Base URL pattern is valid for control plane; data plane uses different hostnames (*.iot.<region>.amazonaws.com). Free-tier limits and API quotas are published. Example understates SigV4 requirements.
